about: I'm Nalla Anikethan Reddy, an Automation Developer currently at KTech Products, specializing in Python and Playwright automation, backed by hands-on experience in AI-driven automation and data analysis. I build reliable, maintainable automation frameworks, integrate them into CI/CD pipelines, and use SQL and Python to validate data integrity end-to-end. Across my roles I've worked on automation frameworks, data analysis pipelines, and AI-assisted workflows, with strong fundamentals in Java, DBMS, SQL, and OOP concepts.
